# Integration Requirements Checklist: Candidate Route Baseline and Role Contracts

**Purpose**: Assess whether client-surface isolation, route-policy producer and consumer inventory, evidence-class separation, Claude-to-Codex semantic parity, and the G56R-002 handoff contract are complete, clear, consistent, and reviewable.
**Created**: 2026-07-14
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Independent Codex Surface Requirements

- [x] CHK001 Are the four target Codex surfaces enumerated with stable values rather than grouped under a generic client label? [Completeness, Spec §FR-020; Data Model §SurfaceRecord]
- [x] CHK002 Is cross-surface inheritance prohibited so CLI evidence cannot silently establish desktop-app, app-server, or non-interactive behavior? [Consistency, Spec §FR-020; Plan §Design Decisions]
- [x] CHK003 Are silence and explicit non-applicability distinguished as `undocumented` and evidence-backed `not_applicable` for each surface? [Clarity, Spec §FR-020; Contract §Evidence and surfaces]
- [x] CHK004 Does every platform provenance record require the target surface, documented client or version scope, applicability, conflict state, and invalidation trigger? [Completeness, Spec §FR-017; Data Model §ProvenanceRecord]
- [x] CHK005 Are equal-authority and applicability conflicts required to remain visible and terminally classified without using recency or local state as an implicit tiebreaker? [Scenario Coverage, Spec §FR-016 and §FR-019]
- [x] CHK006 Can four-surface coverage and absence of cross-surface generalization be assessed objectively from the declared records and success criteria? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005–SC-006; Plan §Requirement and Acceptance Traceability]

## Route-Policy Producer and Consumer Inventory

- [x] CHK007 Are source, installer, skill, validation, evaluation, generated-payload, cache, and installed-state integration classes all within the required inventory boundary? [Coverage, Spec §FR-004–FR-005; Plan §One-Working-Day Execution Sequence]
- [x] CHK008 Does each inventory entry define its locator, integration class, producer or consumer relationship, affected agents and policy fields, authority/evidence class, and upstream/downstream relationship so completeness and conflation are objectively reviewable? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004; Plan §Evidence and Validation Design]
- [x] CHK009 Is the tracked source identified as the only authority for the production project contract while derived payload, cache, and installed surfaces remain non-authoritative observations? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005; Plan §Design Decisions]
- [x] CHK010 Are active route-policy sources and consumers required to be inventoried at one recorded repository revision? [Clarity, Spec §FR-017; Plan §One-Working-Day Execution Sequence]
- [x] CHK011 Are route-policy defects discovered at any integration surface required to be recorded with ownership instead of repaired or allowed to redefine source? [Scenario Coverage, Spec §Scope Boundaries and §FR-027; Plan §Design Decisions]
- [x] CHK012 Is inventory completeness tied to the exact twelve-agent set rather than permitting an unassociated surface list? [Traceability, Spec §FR-002 and §FR-004; Data Model §AgentRecord]

## Tracked, Cache, and Installed Evidence Boundaries

- [x] CHK013 Are `tracked_source`, `cached_source`, and `installed_state` defined as independent observations for every agent? [Completeness, Spec §Clarifications Session 3; Data Model §SourceObservation]
- [x] CHK014 Are common retained observation fields bounded, with repository-relative provenance reserved for tracked source and logical locators reserved for cache and installed evidence? [Clarity, Spec §Clarifications Session 3; Contract §Evidence and surfaces]
- [x] CHK015 Are absolute or home paths, user and host identities, credentials, secrets, and unrelated settings explicitly prohibited from published environment observations? [Coverage, Spec §FR-021; Data Model §ProvenanceRecord]
- [x] CHK016 Is mismatch handling complete for tracked, cached, and installed observations, including a recorded finding, named owner, and no source mutation? [Edge Case Coverage, Spec §FR-005 and §Clarifications Session 3; Data Model §SourceObservation]
- [x] CHK017 Is installation availability kept `unresolved_g56r_002` so one machine's state cannot change project eligibility? [Consistency, Spec §FR-013; Contract §Agent record]
- [x] CHK018 Can sanitization and evidence-class separation be measured without treating cache or installed state as corroborating platform authority? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005–SC-006; Plan §Evidence and Validation Design]

## Claude-to-Codex Semantic Parity

- [x] CHK019 Are `consensus-synthesizer` and `gate-validator` the only two agents permitted to have absent Codex production routes? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003; Contract §Exact agent set and route states]
- [x] CHK020 Does each parity contract map every FR-006 semantic field to an exact Claude source locator, classify it as preserved, Codex-adapted, or not applicable, justify adaptations, and fail closed on an unmapped hard contract? [Measurability, Spec §FR-006–FR-007; Data Model §AgentContract]
- [x] CHK021 Are Claude frontmatter, tool-list syntax, routing, and transport mechanics excluded from the semantic contract and instruction-hash boundary? [Consistency, Spec §Clarifications Session 2; Data Model §Canonical identity rules]
- [x] CHK022 Are the two parity roles still required to have complete role, authorization, safety, grounding, mutation, tool, skill, MCP, sandbox, output, client, and representative-task contracts? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006–FR-007; Data Model §AgentContract]
- [x] CHK023 Is semantic derivation explicitly prevented from implying that a Codex route exists or is executable, available, or qualified? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003, §FR-007, and §FR-018; Contract §Purpose]

## G56R-001 to G56R-002 Handoff Contract

- [x] CHK024 Are artifact presence, exact 12/10/2 coverage, contracts, candidates, provenance, agreement, fixtures, telemetry, unknowns, sanitization, and conflict disposition all included in the objective handoff gate? [Completeness, Spec §FR-024; Data Model §HandoffDecision]
- [x] CHK025 Does the handoff define G56R-002 admission and drift rules, including a passing `go` packet, accepted manifest version, pinned contract/candidate IDs and hashes, preserved eligibility, capability-snapshot binding, rejection of `no_go`, and invalidation on upstream identity drift? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013 and §FR-023–FR-025; Contract §Unknowns and handoff]
- [x] CHK026 Are documentation and inventory closure owned by G56R-001, executable capability and installation availability by G56R-002, and replay, scoring, qualification, and ordering by G56R-003? [Consistency, Spec §FR-023 and §Dependencies; Data Model §ClassifiedUnknown]
- [x] CHK027 Are every deferred unknown's class, impact, owner, required follow-up, and status required without allowing an unknown to become an implicit policy conclusion? [Clarity, Spec §FR-023; Contract §Unknowns and handoff]
- [x] CHK028 Is `no_go` a terminal, reproducible handoff with unmet conditions and available evidence rather than authorization to extend time, reduce deliverables, probe, score, or mutate? [Scenario Coverage, Spec §FR-025 and §FR-027; Data Model §HandoffDecision]
- [x] CHK029 Can a reviewer reproduce the same handoff decision and identify every downstream owner without undocumented judgment? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-009; Plan §Requirement and Acceptance Traceability]

## Notes

- Check items off as completed: `[x]`.
- Record requirement-quality findings inline and use the registered gap marker only when the cited artifacts do not define the required behavior.
- This checklist assesses integration requirements writing; it does not execute candidates, test external platform behavior, or broaden G56R-001 beyond its research-only handoff.
